column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Season the beef generously with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef on all sides in 2 batches, about 8 minutes per batch, then set aside on a plate.
Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat.
Add the onions, carrots and celery and cook, stirring often, until the onions are browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste and cook 2–3 minutes until combined and deep red.
Stir in the wine and return the beef to the pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat until the wine reduces by half, about 25 minutes.
Add the herbs, garlic and stock. Bring to a boil, cover and move to the oven.
Braise until the beef is tender, 2–2 1/2 hours, then lift the beef onto a platter.
Strain the sauce into a measuring cup, skim off the fat, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the beef with the sauce spooned over.
